name: dominodatalab
description: Domino Data Lab skills for Workspaces, Jobs, Compute Environments, Datasets, Projects, Apps, model endpoints and monitoring, MLflow experiment tracking, GenAI tracing, Flows, Spark/Ray/Dask clusters, governance, and the Domino APIs and SDKs

settings.name: Domino URL
settings.description: Only for use outside a Domino Workspace: the address you open Domino at in your browser, for example https://domino.example.com. Leave empty inside a Workspace.

settings.name: Domino Personal Access Token
settings.description: Only for use outside a Domino Workspace: in Domino, Account > Account settings > Personal Access Token > Generate new Token. Kept in your system keychain. Leave empty inside a Workspace.
